svg.aria-label: How modules are registered and looked up
svg.title: How modules are registered and looked up

g.text: the only file that names modules
one name may be a base and an
overlay only if their carriers differ
No init(), no blank imports, no globals.
A Go program can build its own registry.
Info() is constant: called twice, compared
the same name twice in one kind: refused
the constructor's return type is the kind,
so a wrong kind does not compile
